about: Policy hash and policy id vectors (acp wiki/acp/policy-id.md). Each vector: a policy text in the YAML schema (JSON reads as YAML), the creator's 32-byte nonce in hex, the creator's DID in the host's canonical spelling, and the expected policy hash and policy id, both lowercase hex. Every engine that derives policy ids must reproduce every vector.

vectors.name: every construct, as block YAML
vectors.policy:
name: files
description: every construct
meta:
  team: storage
  tier: "1"
resources:
  - name: file
    description: a file
    relations:
      - name: admin
        doc: administers
        manages:
          - reader
          - parent
        types: [actor]
      - name: parent
        types: [dir]
      - name: reader
        doc: may read
        types:
          - actor
          - group->member
      - name: banned
        types: [actor]
    permissions:
      - name: read
        doc: read it
        expr: reader+admin+parent->read-banned
      - name: edit
        expr: (admin & reader) + parent->edit
      - name: delete
  - name: dir
    relations:
      - name: viewer
        types: [actor]
    permissions:
      - name: read
        expr: viewer
      - name: edit
  - name: group
    relations:
      - name: member
        types: [actor, group->member]
